name: FilmCraft
tagline: Professional video editing, rebuilt from scratch in pure Rust
blurb: Source and program monitors, a real timeline and every trim mode, in a native editor written in pure Rust — down to its own codecs.
description:
FilmCraft is a non-linear video editor written from scratch in pure Rust.

Featuring multi-track video and audio timeline, ripple/roll/slip/slide trim modes, color grading wheels, transitions, and native hardware-accelerated playback.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft.git && cd filmcraft && cargo run --release
